highlights_headline: The next update brings HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and completes the named script constants.
highlights_body: HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, while retaining the existing Script struct, parsing and conversions.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled HarfBuzz library and aligns HarfBuzzSharp packages with the new native version; the assembly version remains unchanged.
Adds 30 Script constants to match the bundled native script list, preserving all existing field values and the struct-based programming model.
